verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (/rest/v0), a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, a ReadMe reference whose "Try It!" console generates language snippets, a sandbox, and an MCP server. None of these is an official SDK: the spec and auto-generated snippets are building blocks a developer could use to make a client, not vendor-shipped, installable SDK libraries. The axis applies to an API-offering SaaS product, but nothing in the evidence shows an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
